ModMetaData.name: Mountains of the Rim
ModMetaData.author: Evil Eye Guy
ModMetaData.description: Toggleable mountain roofs built from successive 1x1 RimWorld rock wall tiers. Up to 48 tiers by default, with narrow, irregular contours. A filled stone surface meets the original ground rock wall without adding a replacement base wall. Local stone types determine the colors, including granite and sandstone. Mountain height continues across map boundaries. The roof draws above fog and indoor darkness. Hide it to mine or inspect rooms. Actual roofs, fog, lighting and pathfinding remain unchanged. Includes compatibility with saves containing the original MountainHeightGrid component. RimWorld 1.6; requires Harmony.
